sources.entry: Claude Code System Prompts by Piebald AI - All parts of Claude Code's system prompt, including builtin tool descriptions, sub agent prompts (Plan/Explore/Task), utility prompts (CLAUDE.md, compact, Bash cmd, security review, agent creation, etc.). Updated for each Claude Code version.

summary.one_liner: A catalog of the extracted system prompts, built-in tool descriptions, sub-agent prompts and utility prompts from Claude Code, with token counts, updated per Claude Code release.
summary.what_it_does: This repository lists Claude Code's system prompt pieces, each with an approximate token count, as extracted from the compiled source of the latest npm release of Claude Code. The list is organized into sections such as Agent Prompts (sub-agents like Explore and Plan, creation assistants, slash commands like /code-review, /security-review, /simplify and /schedule, and utility prompts for compaction, session titles and security monitoring) and Data (embedded template files, schema descriptions and reference docs). It also includes a CHANGELOG.md tracking prompt changes across many Claude Code versions. The README states that the repository is updated within minutes of each Claude Code release and that a GitHub release is created per version. Token counts may vary by about ±20 tokens because prompts contain interpolated values.
use_cases: Read how Claude Code's built-in sub-agents and slash commands are instructed
Compare prompt changes between Claude Code versions via the changelog
Find the exact prompt text behind a Claude Code behavior
Check token cost of individual system prompt pieces
Source material for customizing prompts with tweakcc
stack: JavaScript (Claude Code's minified bundle, source of extraction)
notable: Prompts extracted directly from Claude Code's compiled source, so they match what the tool actually uses
Covers 500+ prompt strings including tool descriptions, sub-agent prompts and utility prompts
CHANGELOG.md tracks system prompt changes across 300+ Claude Code versions
Points to tweakcc for patching customized prompts into a local Claude Code installation

caveats: Token counts are approximate and can differ by about ±20 tokens in real sessions due to interpolated variables
Prompts are extracted from minified code and reflect a specific Claude Code version, so they change frequently
